## Hallway image 1.15.0 is unverified

`ghcr.io/living-proof-labs/capability-verifier-hallway:1.15.0` stays published (version tags are
never retagged) but is unpinned and unverified: its index was pushed before the platform check,
which then failed on the buildx attestation manifests, so the native per-arch 12/20 check never
ran on it. Use 1.15.1 (index digest below).
